description_excerpt: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact As a Senior Finance Analyst, you will play an integral role in creating and analyzing financial information to support Intel's business decisions. You will handle reconciliations, financial reporting, variance analysis, and process improvements to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data. By identifying trends and providing actionable insights, you will contribute to enhancing operational efficiency and driving financial performance across Intel's departments and projects.
